name: Hushai
summary: Hushai the Archite, David's friend, who went back to Jerusalem to defeat Ahithophel's counsel during Absalom's revolt. His advice won out, and he sent word to David to cross over quickly.

key_moments.title: Sent Back as a Friend
key_moments.description: Hushai met David with his coat torn and earth on his head. David sent him back to the city to offer to serve Absalom and so defeat Ahithophel's counsel.

key_moments.title: Better Than Ahithophel
key_moments.description: Hushai told Absalom that Ahithophel's advice was not good this time, and urged him to gather all Israel first. Absalom chose Hushai's plan, and Hushai sent word through the priests telling David not to stay the night.
